about: Every new line Take MeeMee Home says, in recording order (the 0.8.0 PRD's Lines tab). Ids start with the game's id (takehome-). It also says MeeMee Rescue's numbers (num-mid-0 to num-end-10), four of its praise lines, its try-again lines, tap-scruffles and too-many, shared with Barney's agreement (0.8.0 PRD, question 3): those stay in games/rescue/lines.json. "pending": true puts a line on the recording page but keeps it out of the game until it's recorded. The class's words for subtraction are still to check (open question 2): they decide the words of takehome-take-away, takehome-is and the word "left", not their ids.
